classes.name: ActionExecutionAdmissionModule
classes.description: Deep private Sekai module whose interface concentrates live Action target resolution, authorization, classification, purpose, namespace, schema, and governed policy admission before any dry-run, approval, denial, limit check, or effect execution.

classes.name: SekaiGrpcTransportAdapter
classes.description: gRPC adapter that authenticates callers, correlates capability-catalog invocations, maps protocol messages and response metadata, and delegates pre-effect Action admission.

classes.name: GovernedActionLifecycleModule
classes.description: Sekai-owned module that resolves action policy, coordinates budget and blast-radius limits, binds policy attestations, commits generic approval transitions, and owns execution outcome and limit-denial audit ordering with post-effect metering.

relations.name: delegates_action_execution_admission_to
relations.description: The gRPC transport delegates ordered pre-effect Action admission after authenticating the caller and resolving catalog correlation.

relations.name: freezes_governed_action_context_from
relations.description: Action execution admission resolves and freezes the governed Action lifecycle context used by subsequent policy, approval, limit, audit, and metering behavior.
